notes.content: [h1]REPLAY UPDATES[/h1][p]The replay version of the player is being overhauled to be a 1:1 recreation of all of your actions! Dives, rolls, slides, dropkicks, and reloads will all now show up in the replay just how you did them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/39dd4b54904df73e718746a9ae25d249dfee3ff6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Muzzle Flashes, Shells, and Smoke[/h2][p]Gun muzzle effects and smoke have also now been updated to show up in the replay! Finally your replays will start to feel like a real full detail action scene. Make John Woo proud with choreographing your own ballistic shootout.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/f226255a1eb5cb79c300a0f9a924211749898c5c.gif"][/img][/p][p]Both of the above clips were recorded in-game with the free cam mode during replay![/p][p][/p][h1]THIRD PERSON MODE[/h1][p]With all of the updates to the replay player, I couldn't resist adding a proper third-person mode to the game! Soon you will be able to experience all of Maximum Action from a whole new perspective. And of course workshop weapons are supported as well![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/9acaceea02f862d074cac14cccf414fe99be2a54.gif"][/img][/p][p]Maximum Payne Maximum Action[/p][p][/p][h1]JUNGLE [/h1][p]Progress on 2 new levels. The Jungle rework and sequel. As well as Arctic 2[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/5dc51d94e9d312bf16f7904bc086b870a11ea767.gif"][/img][/p][p]The tank boss fight sequence in Jungle is being reworked to be a more dynamic and destructive! I designed a new AI and locomotion system for the tank where it will naturally crest and roll over the terrain and crash through objects.[/p][p][/p][h1]ARCTIC 2[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/9c439253f63be76b14dbf7c3ffc31a19daa05cb6.png"][/img]New runway section work in progress![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/c01f1149ec3413f467ae00c8f1a4f97989c2f5e3.gif"][/img][/p][p]Andy (OptionalSpace) has been hard at work on the runway section of Arctic 2! Lots of new destructible walls and an improved layout. Our goal is to make the runway one of the most climactic set pieces in the game.[/p][p][/p][h1]DESTRUCTION UPDATES[/h1][p]New particle effects and destruction. A new spark effect and a whole new optimized particle driven destruction system is coming soon. Even small objects like bottle and cups will dynamically react to your bullets. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/d9eb93ac7b9b4903dc6efcc2f4db35b8cf280908.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/c7e1d3c14121653ae937949978888f514c342115.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]CONTROLLER GLYPHS[/h1][p]Better controller support and SteamDeck Verification in the works. When playing with a controller proper glyphs will now show up throughout the game. The controller re-binding menu has been reworked to also show the glyphs and work much more consistently.[/p][p]Even some controller support has been added to the editor![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/418da2827aabe205a729fa86ea100632435b893e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]ASPECT RATIO SUPPORT[/h1][p]UI has been fixed to better support 4:3 16:10 and ultra-wide monitor resolutions! Play the game in 4:3 for the true arcade experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/4e68ab76dc7569cc8bdececa05b6d73b49dd880b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/ee76cda581b109ffd7bb219a9d4247636dba89ca.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]LOCALIZATION[/h1][p][/p][p]Localization! The Simplified Chinese localization is also still in the works and more language support is coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/aac285d05593ac899ed68d6633e879094ade4edf.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for reading! notes.title: 0.95 New Player Controller Update Release
notes.content:
[h1]NEW PLAYER CONTROLLER[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/f39264e48ab3360e8fb1e0f60dc4452e9dbd260f.gif[/img]
I am so happy to be finally releasing the new player controller update to you all! After months of hard work and fine tuning I think you'll find it is a much needed upgrade to Maximum Action. Dozens of new animations for the player and even more bug fixes. 

[h2]WARNING FOR YOUR EDITOR LEVELS[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/d2ef781a8f18066a28cb9108bb12f39f2ba64462.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/81255e024dfd0f4eb8a46288c02612f71d0928e1.png[/img][/url]
[b]Backup your "AppData\LocalLow\BalloonMoose\Maximum Action\Custom\Levels" Folder!! [/b]
especially if you are on the testing branch!
Myself and others have encountered a bug where Steam cleared the entire folder of anything that wasn't subscribed to. Meaning any non published levels you are working on could potentially be deleted. Working on a fix for this now!
This happened when booting up the game and the workshop items failed to load properly.

[h2]Full Body Awareness and Rock Solid Weapon Handling[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/5ccfb9225658563f36f91e5da1d36325b2915224.jpg[/img]

[b]No more 4 arms swinging around when looking up and down.[/b]

[b]No more head and body dislocation when diving and sliding.[/b]

Every movement has been fine tuned and has a unique full body character animation. From a complete in air diving animation tree to rolling around on the ground. Immersive first person character movement like never before. 
My goal was to upgrade Maximum Action to the polish level of games like Mirrors Edge while still maintaining the same animation style and feel. It's what Maximum Action always should have been. It will feel familiar yet so much improved. 

[h2]New Slide and Slide Kick Animation[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/b1a60eccd3f0518d0d471ac67385b8b8a9c2096e.gif[/img]
Sliding has always been in Maximum Action but it was so subtle it mostly went unnoticed. Not anymore, sliding is now an entire other mode of movement with its own animations. 
Even further, slide and then hold the dive key to infinite slide. The same way you can infinite dive slide while prone by holding the dive key.

[h2]New Cover System with Auto lean and improved animations[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/4ea53954da6d0b14e2ed5228d51df9bf7e9740be.gif[/img]

Use the auto lean to blind fire around corners and even over low cover while crouched. This feature makes it easy to use cover even while playing with a controller!

[i]Player Bullet Hit Detection Fix[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/2cb565951ca7efa6ff92c52f7d7699fd04cf5584.gif[/img]

 Even further player bullet hit detection has been overhauled so you can shoot accurately around tight corners. No more bullets hitting the wall in front of you while leaning or shooting from cover. 

[h3]AI HIT DETECTION FIX[/h3]
Another fix in this update that has been long needed and is still being fine tuned is the enemy bullet detection. Now enemies will correctly aim at the center of the player whether you are diving sliding proning etc. And cover will effectively block their bullets. Until THIS update, the hit detection for enemy bullets against the player would not resize properly when diving sliding crouching. Now you can crouch or lay behind cover and be fully safe from being shot. It's a small fix but you'll notice the combat feels much more tight and accurate, diving and sliding and crouching is much more useful. A beautiful balance of high speed acrobatics and tactical cover shooting. Each equally useful.

[h2]Lots of Settings to Tweak[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/59c8d1519faf298231ab9a3ced1cc1d298d02f89.gif[/img]
Turn on and off lots of aspect of the new player to tune it to your liking. Enable camera rolling and camera tilting to roll forwards and backwards from diving in full motion sickness glory. 

[b]Disable Camera Roll[/b]
Use this to disable and enable camera rolling while player is rolling out of a dive

[b]Dive Camera Tilt[/b]
Enable / Disable camera tilting when diving

[b]Camera Bobbing[/b]
Use this slider to control the camera bobbing rotation intensity of the player

[b]Auto Lean From Cover[/b]
Turn off and on the new auto leaning cover system

In the reverse, turn these off and turn down the camera bobbing to have a stable smooth first person camera experience that still is packed full of detail.

 I personally switch these on and off almost every time I play based on how I'm feeling. Sometimes having your head roll with your body just feels so damn cool. Other times it makes me want to throw up. So give it a try yourself! 

[h2]Delays and Coming Soon[/h2]
There was so much more I wanted to get into this update but I decided to prioritize getting my progress out to you all first for testing before packing on more fixes and new features. For example, I really wanted to get this new player controller working in the replay system as well, and from some initial tests I've done it will work amazingly. Here's some clips of a rough test

[i]New Player Animations In Replay Test[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/ed12f08407f03bdf851490adb8634d51b95b47f1.gif[/img]

I decided to save this for the future since I want to make sure I give it the time to polish and cook it into something really special. Rather than tack it on last minute to this update.

[h2]Coming Soon[/h2]

[i]Jungle 2 Work In Progress Screenshot[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/9357136c5b6bf44f36cd069404486b63a1e4e671.png[/img]

Andy @optionalSpace and I have been working hard on new levels and really wanted to get them in this update but decided we need more testing and feedback from y'all first. Expect to see rough cuts of our new Jungle rework and Arctic 2 levels on the testing branch soon! We have lots of other new levels in the works as well but want to give them the proper time and care to make them maximum action worthy. For those of you craving new content all I can say is sorry and that it is coming soon! Always feel free to hop in the editor or download some workshop levels in the meantime! 

[i]Arctic 2 Work In Progress Screenshot[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/9a735204537f8797504f3b2e3f8e462ea26c0ddd.png[/img]


[h2]Patch Notes Full List[/h2]

[b]NEW SETTINGS AND ANIMATIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] Added setting for disabling camera tilting while diving sideways and diagonally
[*] Camera Bob setting now affects the camera bobbing animation strength
[*] Edited player stop walking animation, toned down so less jarring when stopping movement
[*] Smoothed out camera rolling animation transitions
[*] Fixed bug where after rolling camera could be stuck intensely bobbing
[*] Fixed bug where first person hands slowly drift away from guns
[*] Drop kick added back vertical height boost
[*] New diving tree animations for looking down while in air
[*] New / re-added crouch kick animation
[*] New diving in-air state, if you dive off a high object you will stay in the in-air state until hitting the ground
[*] Fixed leaning animations
[*] New blocked pose, your guns will move backwards near walls to indicate being in cover
[*] New Auto-Lean setting, if you aim or shoot you will automatically lean out of cover if possible
[/list]


[b]PLAYER COLLIDER FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Player bullet hit detection fix, you can now shoot around tight corners without your bullets hitting the wall in front of you
[*] AI-aiming and bullet fix, AI will now correctly aim at the player's center of mass while crouching diving sliding
[*] AI bullet player hit detection fix, the player hit collider now correctly resizes so crouching and diving behind cover correctly blocks enemy bullets
[*] Added Crouch blocking, if you crouch under a low object your player will stay crouched so you don't get stuck in geometry
[*] Tuned player collider size so it's harder to get stuck in shelves and under tables while diving
[/list]

[b]OTHER FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked door physics, when you kick open doors they should no longer fall through the floor and stay in the level
[*] Hopefully fixed bug where parts of the level could get impaled and attached to thrown katanas or cleavers
[*] Fixed RPG rocket and m16 grenade launcher trajectory so it aligns with where you are aiming
[*] Fixed not being able to walk straight bug on controllers
[*] Fixed issue with dropped enemy weapons not giving you ammo in endless mode or campaign levels
[*] AI ragdolls will now stay standing / upright if they are not dead, fixing issue of AI falling over and looking dead and then teleporting back to standing
[*] Added popping up out of cover when crouched to the Auto Lean system
[*] Fixed issue with apache prefab shooting while in the editor
[*] Reduced camera clipping through walls while diving and rolling
[*] Smoothed out transition from sliding and rolling to jumping
[*] Fixed issues with game volume setting in options menu
[*] Fixed Walking on controller not being straight
[*] Fixed Diving on controller not being straight
[*] Fixed issue where diving diagonally would make hands and camera over-rotate right and left
[/list]

Hope you all enjoy this update as much as I did making it!
Please post any bugs you find or feedback in the Maximum Action [url=https://discord.gg/fqc5fwp]Discord[/url]  It would be greatly appreciated!! thanks so much! 
-George Mandell

notes.title: UPDATE 0.90 "THE ROOFTOP" AND AI OVERHAUL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/4a537674a8d5e8e7b67701bd59a8652d65e02a00.gif[/img]

Hey Maximum Action fans! I'm super excited to announce the release of MAXIMUM Action v0.90!

This update is packed with a completely overhauled Rooftop level, new AI, optimization and performance fixes, and much more!

[h1]Reworked and extended the Rooftop level[/h1]

I'm happy to announce I've brought on the extremely talented [b]Andrew Niehaus[/b], aka optionalspace to help create levels for the main campaign of Maximum Action!

You may recognize his work from the workshop with his extremely well-crafted levels like Close The Club, Night Streets, and others!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/2b6226c0079c45f7a8f7c33203b5c3b4f7eb19cc.gif[/img]

"The Rooftop" has been polished and completed with 
[list]
[*] [b]lots of destruction, and more detailed environments[/b]
[*] [b]new props and glass[/b]
[*] [b]enemy helicopters [/b]
[/list]
and a few other surprises ;)

Andy and I put tons of love and care into designing and finishing this level, Andy's attention to detail is awesome and really shows in this completely overhauled level! We hope you all enjoy!

[h1]Complete AI overhaul [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/0dc71f0db9ce264a61fd88197fbad0bfeca0f160.gif[/img]

I finally decided to go back to square one with Maximum Action AI. I have rewritten their behavior from scratch to function as a Finite State Machine (FSM). Taking inspiration from my favorite AI in games, Goldeneye and Half Life, which also have FSM based AI. 

You'll see AI dynamically take cover, dodge out of your line of sight, coordinate attacks with one another, roll, dive, lean out of cover, and much more! 

My goal was to make Maximum Action feel like arcade classics Time Crisis / Virtua Cop but totally off the rails, and I think I got pretty close!

[h2]Other AI Changes/ Performance Improvements[/h2]
I added [b][/b]pooling to the enemy AI as well, this means that there will be much less stutter when AI spawn in the main campaign as well as the endless mode. The game should run much more consistently and load quicker! Especially for levels like Jungle

[h2]Custom levels[/h2]
All of these new AI features also work in custom levels! You may notice some issues / different behavior with your custom levels. But take this opportunity to remaster/touch up your levels with all of the new props and features! There are still some bugs I am ironing out, so please report if you have any issues or problems!

[h1]Detailed Glass Destruction[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/ec480893e4c2185d45076e453ccc979907a2a941.gif[/img]

I developed an entirely new glass destruction system inspired by games like Red Faction and the Duke Nukem Forever 2001 Build!

In levels that feature this new glass, you'll see dynamic bullet holes, shattering, environmental interaction, and even the sounds of glass crunching under your feet when you walk over shattered panes!

And of course, it has been added to the editor! As well as lots of other props and features from this update!

 [h2]Some bugs[/h2]
With all of the new changes to the game and new AI systems, there are going to be some minor bugs and glitches with this new update! Please report any you find either on the Maximum Action  [url=https://discord.gg/fqc5fwp]Discord[/url] or here on the steam forums! 

Thank you all so much for your continued support, and I really hope you enjoy this new update! I had so much fun developing it, and am so happy to have brought on Andy to help out!

notes.title: 0.78.1 Gun and Blood Update
notes.content:
0.78.1 Gun and Blood Update brings a lot of much needed fixes and polish to the core gameplay of Maximum Action!

[h1]Aiming Down Sights[/h1]
Aiming Down Sights on all weapons has been fixed to correctly line up with the center of your screen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/982c203a7d2c5cdabcece2a3655dee0a77f610e5.gif[/img]

This affects mod weapons as well, (some mod weapons may now be slightly misaligned).  

The good news is mod weapons now support custom Aim Down Sights positioning, simply create an empty object in your custom gun model named [b]"adsCameraPosition"[/b] and this will be the place the camera goes when you aim down sights on your custom weapon. No more manually adjusting the offset in the XML file! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/4b5430d013f0fc1d97a7deb330a5df3e9cdf8f7f.png[/img]

You can also now set the position of the barrel, where muzzle flash effects will be emitted from, by creating an empty object named [b]"barrel" [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/fa6ad460b2b45eb3e3c7e244d89af66269367c46.gif[/img]


[h1]New Gun Effects[/h1]
Gun smoke effects when firing have gotten a total overhaul. With effect detail set to MAXIMUM, guns will overheat when firing rapidly and expel smoke from the barrel and chamber when your gun runs empty. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/36bc1c20238084f1730466143f842fbca3d94959.gif[/img]

Some mod weapons may need barrel realignment, either create an empty object in your FBX file named "barrel" which will update the gun barrel smoke position to be aligned with your custom weapon, or simply disable the overheat smoke particles in your custom weapon's XML file by setting [b]<disableOverheatSmoke>[/b] to true. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/657104688c6d060a2296e2873c89d932af0dca86.gif[/img]


Further multiple other small gun bugs have been fixed, such as the lasers on the silenced mp5 and 1911, and the left hand blocking your view when you aim down sights with the single action revolver.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/2ab03fa2559e74e8a1f9bc5714a55bd1e7aa4c44.jpg[/img]


[h1]Improved Blood[/h1]

The blood effects in the game have also seen quite some improvement, with blood detail set to MAXIMUM the game will use much more accurate projectors for the blood and wound decals on enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/833048ff593df967e3194197ce8b40a4ab9b82a9.jpg[/img]

Further the particle effects have recieved some added detail with smoke and sparks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/0a48a8b2c09d8f951e40bc6dbb8d96bff6d64cfb.gif[/img]

[h1]Ragdolls[/h1]
The active ragdoll animations and physics have been overhauled with unique death animations for where you shot a character and lots of fixes/polish to their joint physics for more smooth and weighty reactions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/c185e48b0c6b70e6ab265c2ef1a91f3ac312912e.gif[/img]

There are still some bugs but overall they feel much more alive and will attempt to keep their balance while you're shooting them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/24a7c1806d6d30b19fcb9d06f4ae8aac4949a603.gif[/img]

[h1]Lighting and Optimization[/h1]
A few levels have had some adjustments made to their lighting, mainly the Hospital in Boiled Action, Mean Streets, and The Teahouse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/b3a01aaf8e7c1eb97d9e2cda0e3162a5c76a3004.jpg[/img]

Further, Jungle has recieved some further optimization which should increase the framerate in most parts of the level, and hopefully lower the long load times and crashing. Also, the tank turret now automatically follows your mouse rather than having to be turned manually using 'A' and 'D'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/eff64b15fbdde45b9e12ff69306be04d23344c10.jpg[/img]

And as always,

notes.title: Future Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! George Mandell of Balloon Moose Games here with an official announcement of my future plans for Maximum Action.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/631db71a6ff2b07ea9fa4c5d364fb97a8cd75ed0.png[/img]



[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

[olist]
[*] Shifting the focus
My first order of business is making the game more movie focused. Maximum Action is an ACTION movie game after all, and I want the user interaction, presentation, and levels to reflect that. This means things like:

Cutscene/Intro cinematics 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/6ac3fa838b9f3da80ccd5374e81b44c92626982a.gif[/img]

Level objectives given through a movie script, (think like the mission objectives in Goldeneye)!
These will be pretty loose, and just for unlocking the next level/your replay. I don't intend to restrict the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/9e381335ac3d6f67ab4cd415e379b2afb3ac5d2d.png[/img]

New level selection screen (Work in Progress)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/8538a0f586dd594e0cf015c91f99618e8ba7b867.gif[/img]

VHS/VCR diegetic style for the user interface and interaction

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/3f7c44b05d956e4ebc41dbecb407355dcd2e32b4.gif[/img]

As well as new music designed to emulate the score of 80's/90's action movie classics.


Each level is its own movie that you play a part in!

Further, I plan to rework the replay system to be like a mini movie trailer showing highlights from your gameplay. Your customized character will become very important as they are the star!

Expect to see things like custom one-liners, cheesy boss fights, and credits for your production!


[*] Finishing existing levels

After that, I plan to polish/finish the existing levels, adding things like more destructible environments, vehicles, bosses, and weapons.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/71939cfad1e439880f66110a08f678c319d977fa.gif[/img]


[*] New levels and editor overhaul

Once the current levels reach an acceptable state. I plan to add new levels and overhaul the level editor to create a more streamlined experience. I am looking into allowing custom level importing through FBX files as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/a3e06a5671be69317b867ef5dd08b418db02e0d0.jpg[/img]

[*] Increased mod support and Co-op

Finally, before releasing into 1.0. I want to expand the mod-ability of the game, hopefully to allow more custom content on the Steam Workshop such as character models and voice lines.

Further, I plan to experiment with adding co operative game play modes into the game. No promises here as I still have some research to do on whether this is feasible.

[*]Then full release into version 1.0!

[/olist] 

I want to thank everyone for their support and excitement regarding the future of the game! Hope you all stay tuned! I have been consistently developing this game since about 2015 and I have no intention of stopping, I am personally very excited to see how far I can take it.

notes.title: The 'Endless Action' Update
notes.content:
[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/ZXklvJmwCUUEb2mAvZ/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Forever[/i]? [b]FOREVER[/b].

That's how long you can now play [b][i]MAXIMUM Action[/i][/b] thanks to our new [b]'Endless Action'[/b] Update.

So what [b]EXACTLY [/b]have we added, action stars?!

[i]WE'RE GLAD YOU ASKED[/i]

[h1]Completely [b]REWORKED [/b]Endless Mode[/h1] (Leaderboards coming soon)

Now with proper scoring, scaling and even loading & death screens. 
(so it doesn't seem like the game is freezing between waves) [b]You're welcome.[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kGXVb0E8p1LNWV4nSy/giphy.gif[/img]

We've repurposed all of the "cut content" and come up with 
[b]EIGHT[/b] solid AF endless levels for you to kick ass in. [b]Yeehaw.[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/H8F7xB8417vyslwFFB/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Xy7A87i40Qt9Qw47Hv/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/VGK3wsqDG8vlj4DICj/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Including a brand new [b]OFFICES [/b]level featuring trinkets from other [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/NewBlood/list/32813]New Blood[/url] games.[/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/QwzjheRKTatM8KkBoq/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Improved Gun Room[/b] and [h1]BRAND NEW shooting range [/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/hsn1l41WQIHosG0KVI/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Want to test out all the guns in the game? 
Want to test out all the guns on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/853770/workshop/]workshop[/url]? 
Want to just stand around and stare at a bunch of guns?![/i] [b]WELL NOW YOU CAN.[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Q7KnomHJeb5yPH0ImC/giphy.gif[/img]

We've even added a high score game. [b]Bang bang. Shoot shoot.[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/WqAFGBHU5ujcrPk7ra/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]PROGRESSION?! [/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/H8Dzhm6rf1gxEtCCYP/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Hints of a campaign? Replayability? Collectibles?[/i] [b]No WAY.[/b]

You'll now notice that levels are [b]locked [/b]until you beat the previous level.
To unlock endless levels you'll have to find VHS tapes within the levels.
[i]EZPZ grenade squeezey. [/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/UTen1qC8iitgSduyQd/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Are we Tony Hawking this sh*t?[/i] [b]You bet your ass.[/b]

Already played the game and don't want to unlock everything again? [b]ALL GOOD.[/b]

Just Use the console with ~ and then type in 'Unlock All Levels'

Does this make all the levels good? [b]No[/b]. Can you now press F1 to quick restart? [b]YES[/b].

[h1]New Tutorial[/h1]
The old tutorial? [b]Wack[/b]. The NEW tutorial? [b]Dank[/b].

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZcQ72Zpe8ROBpggJsC/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kDHdSLDCcs18GjYfG2/giphy.gif[/img]

Oh, [i]you can also flip your guns now[/i] (scroll your mouse wheel)

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/W6cwERKWqMYtyWcksz/giphy.gif[/img]

and you didn't think we'd drop a new update without dropping
[h1]A new track from HJP[/h1] ...did you?

[previewyoutube=k3hggi_iJug;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1][i]Yeah, that sh*t slaps.[/i][/h1]
[i]ANYWAY[/i], we hope you love the direction we're taking [i]MAXIMUM Action[/i] in 
as much as we love making it for you. 

We'll  see you next time, [i]ACTION [/i]Stars.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lRdOvGpflbseA62PkN/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: (v.69) Good Luck Parking
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/VFr8ntRfdFanQDRtPM/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Welcome back, movie stars![/h1]
Been awhile since we've given you an [b]OFFICIAL[/b] rundown of what we've added to your "shoots", and what you'll be filming next... so let's dig in to what's in [i]MAXIMUM Action[/i] v.69...[b] Nice.[/b]

[h1]A NEW LEVEL[/h1]
[i][b]GOOD LUCK PARKING[/b][/i]

The first level [i]fully [/i]built by the [i]DUSK [/i]Dad himself, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/davidszymanski]David Szymanski[/url]!

[i]It's got:[/i]

[b]CARS[/b]!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Y0VreSICO2W6H6M8KU/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]EXPLOSIONS[/b]!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/STwknLdUOfDRzC9jEb/giphy.gif[/img]

and... [b]GUNS![/b] (duh)

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/VJkKL6Y5xy5oj1cFtM/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]So have at it.[/i]

But wait... [b]there's more![/b]

We've added...
[h1]A new HUD![/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/J4a0qywbijBIUikdQJ/giphy.gif[/img]

Not only is this HUD easy on the eyes...
You'll find it's much more [u]readable[/u] with all the [i]ACTION [/i]you'll have going on.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/h8Oo8S0LZ50dQrMzk4/giphy.gif[/img]

It's got [b]BIG NUMBERS[/b] because you've got [b]BIG GUNS[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/02c9e3de3fcb551277400d729c5b43f0760c6d44.png[/img]

There's also...
[h1]New features![/h1]
We've added subtle outlines to nearby weapons that you can pick up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33247245/b9aabf224f342122a2d3426c3f06c18966d06ddf.png[/img]

More importantly, you can now continue to pick up weapons without dropping them!

That's right - just [b]JUST KEEP MASHING [F][/b]
and you'll keep picking up and rotating weapons without having to drop them! (finally) 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/hrv3BIls8TBsZMT4zj/giphy.gif[/img]

We've also sped up 'weapon grabbing' out of mid air for [b]MAXIMUM PRECISION[/b].

[i]Check this sh!t out:[/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TFOYOh0tLKWyNZYtWU/giphy.gif[/img]

Better yet, we've added [b]reload canceling[/b], the ability to [b]fire while your other gun is reloading[/b] AND [b]sped up reloading during [i]ACTION TIME[/i][/b] so now you won't find yourself getting caught in slo mo reloads. [b]Killer.[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YrAvdYo16rVkDU22Zl/giphy.gif[/img]

FULL PATCH NOTES [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/853770/discussions/0/1640915206463507624/]HERE[/url]

[h1]But What's Next?![/h1]
We're improving [b]Endless Mode[/b] and adding a new level to it!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l0japqW6yZ21L3tmsb/giphy.gif[/img]

And we've also been overhauling the game's [b]very necessary tutorials[/b] and are nearly done with it.

We think you'll dig the [b]A E S T H E T I C[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZcQ72Zpe8ROBpggJsC/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]But when can you expect these next updates?![/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZXklvJmwCUUEb2mAvZ/giphy.gif[/img]

You guessed it...

[h1]SOON™[/h1]

notes.title: MAXIMUM Destruction
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/PjmZR9DFVK7HYWRszI/giphy.gif[/img]
[i][h1][b]Hey movie stars![/b][/h1][/i]
[i][b]Been a minute, hasn't it?[/b][/i]

[b]Well[/b], since we released the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/853770/workshop/]MAXIMUM Weapon & Level Workshop[/url]...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33247245/1558a67a102e2e04204f53147f111553a99b2e45.png[/img]

We've spent the last 3 updates cleaning up the remaining workshop issues and making sure that you [i]movie star[/i] modders can update + edit existing workshop mods as well as automatically delete mods you've unsubscribed to. [i]You know, important stuff![/i]

[h1][b]Check out the patch notes HERE:[/b] [/h1]https://steamcommunity.com/app/853770/discussions/0/1640915206463507624/

We've taken some time since then to re-organize the project files in preparation for what you've all really been waiting for...

[h1][b]CONTENT.[/b][/h1]
Oh yes, we've started working and re-working on existing and [u]brand new[/u] [i]MAXIMUM Action[/i] scenes for you to blast through. But as you can see, that's not all...

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/PmAeG2sE1zN3L0CAqG/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]We also promised you more... [/b]
[h1][i]DESTRUCTION[/i], [i]DYNAMIC LIGHTING[/i] and [i]SHADOWS[/i].[/h1]
[b]Now we're about to deliver:[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K4ccY7vM_Yg
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/egAcbtkPoZif7x3R41/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1][b]So what can you expect???[/b][/h1]
Well, as you might have guessed, George + David have redone [i]The Hospital[/i] scene from [i]Hard Boiled[/i], [b]complete with all the new lighting, shadows and destruction you've seen above.[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/cP5RgpfwnwjbwsymiF/giphy.gif[/img]

It's also being turned into 3-4 sublevels that will combine the [i]parking garage[/i], [i]hospital[/i], and then [i]the rooftop[/i]. It won't be so easy to fight your way out of this one anymore, movie stars - but we have faith that with enough [b]ACTION[/b]... [i]anything is possible.[/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/XZOBH6gsEnBzpa5pDG/giphy.gif[/img]

We're also working on a new Western Saloon level, fixing up the movement and control mechanics... and I've heard that George is now determined to recreate the "[url=https://youtu.be/BFVyeckjkpQ]Mile High Club[/url]" mission from [i]Modern Warfare.[/i] [b][url=https://twitter.com/DaveOshry/status/1163269324674461697]BRUH[/url][/b]. 

[h1][i][b]Want to keep up to the minute with our MAXIMUM development?![/b][/i][/h1]
You can follow George [b]HERE[/b]: https://twitter.com/BalloonMoose
David [b]HERE[/b]: https://twitter.com/DUSKdev
Johnny [b]HERE[/b]: https://twitter.com/Cr2CrStudios
New Blood [b]HERE[/b]: https://twitter.com/TheNewBloods
...and me? [b]HERE[/b]: https://twitter.com/DaveOshry

And don't forget - we want to build [i]MAXIMUM Action[/i] with [b]YOU[/b], the players. So post all your ideas here on the forums or you can always come talk to us directly in Discord.gg/NewBlood

[h1][b]Until next time, ACTION TO THE MAX! [/b][/h1]ːleatherneckː

notes.title: NEW BLOOD
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/igV8hSuW0iqI9GpO9P/giphy.gif[/img]
[h1][i][b]What's up, movie stars?![/b][/i][/h1]

Oshcuro here, your [b]NEW [/b]director.
 
You might know me from hits such as [i]DUSK,[/i] [i]Kung Fury[/i]... and now... [b][i]MAXIMUM Action.[/i][/b]
https://youtu.be/-piOsWDtsfA My Studio, [i]New Blood Interactive[/i], has been [i]secretly [/i]working with George a/k/a BalloonMoose on [i]MAXIMUM Action[/i] since early 2019 (hence the recent updates) and now we're finally ready to [b]fully [/b]reveal our plans for the game moving forward!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/SYjfuv90Rfezvzi5uV/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]You may have noticed that almost ALL the menus have been revamped[/h1]

[i]Pretty snazzy eh?[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33247245/a115b33bc55ed00cf2f8fca709f8535c19fb3329.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33247245/0291ec75a44fe2b1c77b203f6d5979dfa7b2e008.png[/img]

[h1]We'll also be redoing the entire game HUD, UI and UX moving forward[/h1][i] for a smooth and dazzling retro experience.[/i] 

You want that VHS aesthetic? [b]We're giving it to ya.
[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33247245/c31c6c9d8d42b3594a4bf0a22c01a43bafd3cf5d.png[/img]

But that's the easy part. The harder part will be [b]reworking the movement and controls[/b] (yes, with full controller support) to make sure [i]MAXIMUM Action[/i] isn't just a fun, janky, bullet filled menagerie of over the top violence - it's going to be a [i]smooth and precise[/i] one, too. 

[h1]Don't worry - the [i]DUSK[/i] dudes are on the case. [/h1]

We might even give y'all some real time lighting effects...
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZD3aKqiZGW57i4V4ts/giphy.gif[/img]
(But no promises)

Yet making the game [b]LOOK [/b]and [b]FEEL [/b]better doesn't mean a damn thing if there's not [b]CONTENT [/b]to play. And boy are we gonna give you some [b]CONTENT[/b]. 

[h1][b]New Blood is bringing you a whole new batch of scenes to direct and star in - including some of the all time great ACTION scenes in movie history...[/b][/h1]

[b]The Matrix lobby?[/b] [i]You got it.[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/K3MeF69qjhyjS/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Hard Boiled?[/b] [i]You know it.
[/i]
[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/85bc470919cebc99588f75659c7d4e69/tumblr_n2v3gbDdnT1sgrxw6o1_500.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/934963328088199732/23A5073227B14756AF47ABB8D57E9FA2FA4E7F22/[/img]

[b]The church from Kingsman?[/b] [i]Oh hell yeah.[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8rKXOsIFbrCjm/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]A melee only dojo scene like Ip Man?[/b] [i]You bet your ass.[/i]
[img]https://66.media.tumblr.com/fe2aa9bb31e29f35534e067ad343d0bb/tumblr_opnj6psFFX1qcxymno2_500.gif[/img]

All this is coming and [b]MORE[/b]. And you [b]KNOW [/b]we're open to suggestions, so let us know what scenes YOU want us to create. Discord.gg/NewBlood

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RJ2oDyejzgtrBXv68J/giphy.gif[/img]

But more importantly - we want to make [b]YOU [/b]the directors of your favorite [i]ACTION [/i]movie scenes. 

[h1][b]So we've just launched the ALPHA version of the MAXIMUM Steam Workshop![/b][/h1]

https://steamcommunity.com/app/853770/workshop/

There are already 40+ maps on there including some fan favorites like E1M1 from [i]DOOM[/i]. 

[h1]Rip and Tear (and shoot) UNTIL IT IS DONE.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33247245/3ea28de8f29a6034706674a324a55e52ffc71306.jpg[/img]

[i][b]But that's not all... [/b][/i]

Maps and scenes are only [b]ONE [/b]part of the [i]ACTION[/i]you know and love.

[h1]The other part? WEAPONS.[/h1]

Which is why our [b]NEXT [/b]update will include [b]WEAPON MODS[/b] for Steam Workshop. And the first weapons coming at ya?

[h1]A brand new CROSSBOW...[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33247245/e6bbc381175786b279b7fd54ce63406c1150b951.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33247245/bf0ef15de588a79d00fc6436b4cdf11f98d2460f.png[/img]

[h1]AND... The Crossbow from [i]DUSK[/i].[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33247245/2731aff63bd81ea59d42a405aa32804cd49efa0b.jpg[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kG9pnlU8dlFQ0iNTdj/giphy.gif[/img]

We're also going to be adding more silly options like the newly implemented... 

[h1]Family Friendly Mode™[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/hTsT5HTy8tUdMHLWdg/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Just think of the possibilities![/i]

[i]I guess we'll also add a proper replay system at some point when the alpha replays stop being so damn funny...[/i]

[h1][b]MOST importantly - we want to build this game WITH you. [/b][/h1]

You can always find us here on the forums or in Discord.gg/NewBlood with 10,000 other movie stars who like to blow sh!t up in slow motion.

[h1]Be sure to check our our other games:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/NewBlood/list/32813

[h1]Bother us on social media:[/h1]
https://twitter.com/DaveOshry
https://twitter.com/TheNewBloods
https://www.facebook.com/TheNewBloods

[i][b]And in the meantime... [/b][/i]

Replay those scenes, build those maps, kick some ass and take some names. ːTRː

[b][i]Oshcuro, out.[/i][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/853770/MAXIMUM_Action/

[list]
[*] New UI, UX and HUD

notes.title: MAXIMUM Stability Fixes!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/h8If5TptPdOnSC3jUx/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1][b]The MAXIMUM Action Stability Hotfix #1 has arrived![/b][/h1]

In preparation for our upcoming update, the [i]MAXIMUM Development Team™[/i] collectively decided to release some bits of said earlier than others as a hotfix so you guys can get the [b]important [/b]fixes a little earlier. In this case, we're talking about:
[list]
[*] [b]Lag Teleporting Fix[/b] - This was the biggest bug! No more of that stuff. Players and enemies should both no longer teleport outside the level! Hooray.

[*][b]Physics System Refactor[/b] - The lag teleporting fix required a refactor of many physics-based elements, including:
                        - [b]Crouching:[/b] Stuttering crouch is fixed.
                        - [b]Diving[/b]: Diving has been refactored.
[/list]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZbNncGnqJCMPG6QUOe/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Mouse Stuttering Fix[/b] - The mouse should behave as normal without dropping frames of input. You're welcome.

[*] [b]Arctic Level Enemies[/b] - They now have weapons as intended. [i]Aww.[/i]

[*] [b]Throwing Objects Go Places[/b] - Thrown objects aren't mushy. [i]Throw them with extreme prejudice![/i]

[*] [b]A new logo in the main menu[/b] - This was [i]super important.[/i]
[/list]

[i]This was along with several other fixes.[/i] [b]FULL[/b] patch notes can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/853770/discussions/0/1642038749310865234/]here.[/url]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KGkFKq9O3SJ3X49SfH/giphy.gif[/img]

The rest of the coming update will be out in the weeks ahead. Expect custom content (Steam Workshop!) updates, a reformatted UI and menus (check out that snazzy new main menu), and some cool news on top of that. 

[i][b]SOON™[/b][/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33247245/a115b33bc55ed00cf2f8fca709f8535c19fb3329.png[/img]

[h1][b]Thanks for supporting MAXIMUM Action! It really does mean a lot![/b][/h1]

[i]-George and John, MA Team.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/853770/MAXIMUM_Action/

notes.title: Foundation Update LIVE
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Y3H7fNWM0K1CXWtMBC/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1][b]MAXIMUM UPDATE time![/b] [i]The Foundation Update #1[/i] (.42) is live![/h1]

[i](For detailed change-log specs, plz see the Steam forums discussion [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/853770/discussions/0/1649918058722835024/]here[/url]).[/i]

This update is [b]focusing highly on starting the process of stabilizing the game as-is.[/b] 

We tackled a lot of the "ease-of-life" issues that hadn't been addressed yet. That said, some of the "need to refactor large amounts of the codebase issues" [i](specifically lag teleporting and the replay system) [/i]have been pushed out to [i]Foundation Update #2[/i] since they're a much bigger issue than just changing something that we've already made in the past. (Read: those will be addressed very soon, but they're big enough changes that one of us will need to spend a whole update just on that and nothing else.) 

[h1][i]For a full list of the many bug fixes we did, check the discussion on the Steam forums.[/i][/h1]

We also added some much-needed options in the menu, including the [b]ability to turn vsync off[/b],[b] turn mouse acceleration off[/b], and [b]invert your mouse controls if needed[/b]. Thanks for pointing those out to us. :)

[b]MA is also now be compatible with all sizes of monitors instead of solely 16:9 as it was before.[/b] We know some of you guys have been really hoping for this to happen ASAP, so we made sure to prioritize it for your sake.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/IgpJzocE8QPuWXKFOy/giphy.gif[/img]

This update period we also spent [b]a lot of time working on some things that aren't quite finished as of right now,[/b] but we're really excited about them so I wanted to mention them here too!

[i][b]Besides a ton of general polish, revamped menus, HUD and UI[/b][/i] - we've been working on getting [u][b]Steam Workshop support[/b][/u] implemented for the level editor ([b]and another SECRET upcoming feature[/b]) and am happy to say that it's definitely going to be coming in the next update, barring nothing unexpected happening. This will allow all of you to upload levels (and other SECRET things) from inside MA to the workshop and subscribe to other people's content. These features are not far off from being testable. We'll be giving details on the User Creation Update #1 coming up in a couple weeks. [i][b]Keep your eyes peeled.[/b][/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/W1O92wUE1uD9X3qAP3/giphy.gif[/img]

That's what we have to share for the moment! Although this update was very needed on our end, I'm looking forward to the upcoming updates we have planned 'cause [b]we have some really super cool stuff to share with you guys and I can't wait.[/b] :) Thanks to every one of you that are supporting this project. It means the world to both of us (but especially George).

[b]Also, don't forget to get your Mom a gift. :)[/b]
--- George and John, the MA Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/853770/Maximum_Action/

notes.title: Update on Project, and Hi!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lnz6adhVO0VeYhyMrb/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Hey guys [/b]- sorry it's been a little while since we have posted an official announcement. I'm John, who's coming alongside George to help out with the project so he can focus on the more important stuff while I tackle the more "bug-fixy" things.

George has been working every day since the last update hit, and with our POWER COMBINED, things are moving along really nicely. Although we haven't put together any sort of schedule, George and I both agree we'd like to start making [b]regular communication about updates more of a priority.[/b] Although we're not sure exactly what that will look like, I CAN tell you that we have an update planned to be released very soon, [b]possibly next week if we can get it together in time - we'll see how things progress.[/b] More on that soon.

I'm making a point to be active on the Steam forums here, which I check daily, so if you have suggestions, bugs, or want to talk to the dev team, that should be a good place to do so from here on out. :)

We appreciate all of you more than we can say. Thanks for investing in this project. We'll have a lot more to show and tell you... SOON

-The MA Team
